description:
Hey there! Thanks for stopping by. We’re Airtasker, the Australian tech company that connects people who need to get things done with those who have the skills to do it. We are Australia’s number 1 marketplace for local services, headquartered in Sydney, creating more than $1bn of income since we started in 2012 for our community members.

It doesn’t stop there though, we have since gone global through taking Airtasker to the US and the UK creating new marketplaces in these areas of huge opportunity!

Our mission is to empower people to realise the full value of their skills. This doesn’t just apply to those who use our product. It’s also for our whole team of go-getters who bring the product to life and deliver impact to our community on a daily basis. Because we believe work (and life) is always better when you truly know and appreciate your strengths and skills.

Ready to build things people actually use? At Airtasker, you’ll ship full-stack features from first pixel to final API, across React, Kotlin, Go and Rails. You’ll own your work end to end, help shape our move to modern architecture, and work alongside a distributed team across Australia, Portugal and Vietnam. If you like picking the right tool for the job (and know when simple beats clever), you’ll feel at home here.

This role is based in Hanoi with 2 days per week in the office.

What you’ll do:

  • Design and build full-stack features across our React/TypeScript frontend and Kotlin, Go and Rails backends

  • Craft robust API integrations using our BFF (Backend for Frontend) patterns

  • Create responsive, accessible interfaces with our design system

  • Write thorough tests and strengthen our CI/CD practices

  • Improve observability and monitoring, including a spot on the on-call roster

  • Mentor teammates and help raise our engineering standards

 

What it takes to be successful in the role:

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong foundation in either frontend or backend for customer-facing web applications

  • Experience with database design, schema changes and REST/gRPC API design

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), containerisation and automated deployment

  • Comfort working across multiple languages and stacks, and an appetite for moving between them

  • Confidence using AI tooling and setting up environments where agents can deliver well

  • Clear communication in distributed, async teams

  • Strong problem-solving judgement, product thinking and attention to craft

  • Ownership, autonomy and a habit of continuous learning

 

Why you’ll love working here

We empower everyone at Airtasker to realise the full value of their skills, and we’re lucky that the mission behind our marketplace is one we get to live inside the business too. We see everyone as an individual, and we’re proud of the collaborative, diverse and high performing culture we’ve built together.

 

Here’s a taste of what’s on offer.

 

Thriving

  • Hybrid working: we come together in our Hanoi office on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and you choose where you work the rest of the week.

  • Airtime: meeting-light Fridays for deep, focused work, while staying online and responsive as usual.

  • Recharge days: a company-wide Recharge Day each quarter, equivalent to 4 extra days of leave a year.

Rewarding

  • Tenure leave: from your 3rd anniversary, 3 extra days of leave a year, rising to a maximum of 5.

  • Birthday leave: an extra day of leave in your birthday week.

  • Celebration swap: swap national, state or territory public holidays for the ones that matter to you.

Growing and belonging

  • Airpowerment Fund and learning allowance: 4,200,000₫ per year to spend on anything that supports either your health and wellbeing or learning and development.

  • Global company: we operate across more than one country, so your work and ideas can reach well beyond a single market.

  • Belonging and celebrating: join DAREtasker, our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion committee, or the Vibe Committee, and help us celebrate each other through our peer-nominated Values Awards.

 

At Airtasker we believe in culture add: each person brings their own background and experiences to our cultural tapestry. We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds.

#LI-TR1 #LI-Hybrid
